orchestratorChecks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $acceptanceCoverageRoot=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('fnd001s-acceptance-coverage-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); $baselineDir=Join-Path $acceptanceCoverageRoot 'baseline'; $coverageDir=Join-Path $acceptanceCoverageRoot 'coverage'; $probePath=Join-Path $acceptanceCoverageRoot 'astro_rendering_topology_contract.ts'; $archivePath=Join-Path $acceptanceCoverageRoot 'baseline.tar'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $acceptanceCoverageRoot,$baselineDir | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'tools/architecture/FND-001S/astro_rendering_topology_contract_test.ts' -Destination $probePath; $allowRead='--allow-read=AGENTS.md,docs/architecture/decisions/0001-astro-personalized-rendering.md,docs/architecture/technology-baseline.md,docs/architecture/compose-contract.md,docs/architecture/configuration-and-secrets.md,docs/architecture/observability.md,docs/product/page-catalog.yaml'; deno test --quiet --coverage=$coverageDir --clean $allowRead $probePath; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'candidate coverage run failed' }; git archive --format=tar --output=$archivePath 976e01716145aa29cc8b5ab22c22210689234ecd; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'baseline archive failed' }; tar -xf $archivePath -C $baselineDir; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'baseline extraction failed' }; Push-Location $baselineDir; try { deno test --quiet --coverage=$coverageDir $allowRead $probePath; $expectedRedExit=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($expectedRedExit -ne 1) { throw "baseline coverage run expected exit 1, got $expectedRedExit" }; deno coverage --detailed --threshold=100 --include='astro_rendering_topology_contract\.ts$' $coverageDir; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'exact coverage threshold failed' } } finally { Pop-Location }; $probeSha=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $probePath).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($probeSha -ne '6cb3610ece718bb420654301cf12cf94a2987385ef99e0a92d295533f0711542') { throw 'coverage probe digest mismatch' }; Write-Output 'candidate green, baseline RED discriminated, frozen probe preserved, exact coverage 100 percent'
